lessons.title: Pay the bill and understand service
lessons.objective: Ask for the bill, check the charges, ask about service and tipping, and pay at a restaurant table.
lessons.focus: Asking for the bill, checking the total and service charge, asking whether service is included, and paying by card.
lessons.scene: After dinner, the guest asks for the bill and sees a service charge on the receipt. The waiter explains the restaurant's policy for large tables. Because service is already included, the guest leaves a small cash tip, pays by credit card, and thanks the chef before leaving.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: combine reservation, arrival, ordering courses, an allergy question, and paying from lessons 1–14 in one ordinary evening
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Get through an ordinary dinner reservation from the host stand to the bill, with one small change along the way.
lessons.title: Dinner from reservation to bill
lessons.objective: Combine reservation, arrival, ordering courses, an allergy question, and paying from lessons 1–14 in one ordinary evening.
lessons.focus: Giving a reservation name, ordering courses, asking about nuts and shared pans, changing the dessert, and asking for the check.
lessons.scene: Ana arrives at 8 for her reservation and is taken to her table. She orders soup and fish with a glass of white wine. Because she is allergic to nuts, she asks whether the dish has nuts and whether the same pans are used. The waiter checks with the chef and explains that the dish has nuts, but the chef will make it without nuts and in a clean pan. Ana asks to change her dessert to fruit, then asks for the check, sees that the tip is not included, and pays by card.
